scientific_integrity: The all-size theorem rests on a written Fourier counting proof and a cyclotomic norm lemma. Publication priority and independent validation are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted simple Möbius ladder with equal unit couplings, zero site potentials and infinite-time Cesàro mixing only; possible stronger unlocated circulant theorem; finite checks are corroborative, not proof.
title: Arithmetic parity jumps in Möbius-ladder quantum average mixing
